Subject: Follow-up: security & KMS questions from today’s discovery

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking time today — really helpful to understand FinBank’s ingestion patterns and regulatory constraints. A quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: You run PII-heavy document ingestion for loan reviews and KYC; peak throughput ~200 concurrent requests, typical seq length ~1k tokens. You need HIPAA-like controls for certain data flows and want to evaluate customer-managed key options.
- Compliance: We are SOC 2 Type II and maintain GDPR controls; I attached our SOC 2 report and a short security overview.
- KMS/KMS options: Redwood supports both provider-managed KMS and customer-managed keys (CMK) via AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and HSM integrations for Private deployments. We also support bring-your-own-key (BYOK) workflows and envelope encryption for at-rest keys.
- Next steps I propose: 1) I’ll share our SOC 2 doc + security overview (attached); 2) Aditya (cc’d), our solutions engineer, can join a technical call next week to walk through KMS/HSM details and architecture diagrams; 3) If you prefer, complete the attached vendor security questionnaire and we’ll return answers within 3 business days.

Can you confirm which option you’d like us to deep-dive on (CMK via AWS KMS vs HSM-backed appliances in Private) and a couple time slots next week for a 45-minute technical call?

Thanks —
Marissa

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap. A few clarifying questions before we schedule the technical call: 

1) For customer-managed keys: does Redwood support a BYOK flow where the key material never leaves our HSM? We need to ensure FinBank holds the only key material for decrypting any persisted content.
2) For in-transit encryption, do you terminate TLS at Redwood by default? What options exist for end-to-end encryption where only our side can terminate?
3) Regarding SOC 2: is the attached report a full Type II (period cover) or a redacted summary? We’ll need the full report for our procurement/compliance team.

Also attaching our vendor security questionnaire — can you indicate who on your team will take point and an ETA for responses?

Thanks,

Hi Samir —

Great questions — quick answers below and we can cover details on the technical call: 

1) BYOK / key material: For Hosted deployments we support customer-managed keys via cloud KMS (AWS/GCP) where the customer controls key access and can revoke. In Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) we support HSM-backed key stores where key material can be generated and kept in the customer’s HSM; Redwood never has access to raw key material in that mode. We use envelope encryption so model caches and persistent artifacts are encrypted with data keys wrapped by your CMK.

2) In-transit: We terminate TLS at the edge by default for hosted endpoints to allow DDoS protection and routing; however, we support mutual TLS and VPN-based private connectivity for Private deployments so you effectively control termination. We can also support client-side encryption for highly sensitive payloads so data remains opaque to Redwood until the customer-side has decrypted.

3) SOC 2: The attached PDF is our full SOC 2 Type II report for the 12-month period ending Dec 31, 2025. If you need an NDA or additional redactions for procurement, we can accommodate via our security portal.

Who will be completing the questionnaire? If you want, Aditya can take point on the technical Qs and I’ll coordinate for procurement/compliance items. ETA for questionnaire: we aim to return a completed response within 3 business days after we get it.

Proposed times for tech call (PST): Mon 6/29 10:00–10:45am, Tue 6/30 1:00–1:45pm, Wed 7/1 9:00–9:45am. Please let us know which works and we’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda and a brief architecture diagram.

Best,
Marissa
